Realistic sculptural rose and salmon heart tissue with warm ivory endocardial lining, a very subtle translucent blue-grey chest and ribs for context, rich midnight charcoal and deep teal background, refined studio illumination and tactile material detail, beautifully legible silhouette at small size, generous margins. An external ultrasound probe is clearly outside the body and a restrained translucent amber scan plane extends from its tip through the anatomy. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, watermark, ECG, ultrasound screen or fabricated ultrasound frame. Single icon only, no grid or contact sheet. SUBCOSTAL INFERIOR VENA CAVA LONG-AXIS conceptual view. Keep a warm rose right atrium and a modest partial heart above, with a broad smooth dark burgundy inferior vena cava ascending vertically through a subtle translucent brown liver to its right atrial junction. The continuous IVC-to-right-atrium path is the central visual subject; no arterial arch. An external phased-array probe rests below the xiphoid on the upper abdominal surface and sends a restrained amber longitudinal plane superiorly through the liver and IVC. Very subtle ribs and diaphragm contextualize the inferior abdominal window. The liver and venous path should remain clearly distinguished from cardiac muscle. Balanced close composition, no labels.
